description.value: Sushi Today is a compact sushi restaurant on Hornby Street in the heart of downtown Vancouver, a block from the seawall and along a major protected cycling corridor. The restaurant emphasizes fresh, high-quality ingredients and offers a focused Japanese menu with indoor seating. It is a convenient midday or early-evening stop for cyclists exploring the downtown waterfront loop.
